C_lts_matt_donnelly.name: Matt Donnelly
C_lts_matt_donnelly.role: would-be leader / hunger for useful authority

C_lts_kevin_marsh.name: Kevin Marsh
C_lts_kevin_marsh.role: risk forecaster / socially hesitant warning voice

S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.name: Harbor Phase — Inland City
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.text: Harbor Phase — Inland City — Busy adapted coastal city with commuters, families, shops, cafes, occupied apartments, raised transit, flood-control gates, playgrounds and public-service screens. Gray-blue rain, civic glass, warm human interiors, wet paving and practical public lighting.

S_lts_harbor_phase.name: Harbor Phase — Civic Systems View
S_lts_harbor_phase.text: Harbor Phase — Civic Systems View — Wide civic view of a functioning inland coastal city whose flood adaptation works: transit, homes, freight, shops, public space, and ordinary evening life. Visual language: gray-blue rain, raised rail, flood-control gates, apartment windows, civic screens, automated vehicles, storefront warmth, wet glass and concrete.

S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.name: Harbor Phase — Elevated Transit
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.text: Harbor Phase — Elevated Transit — Raised transit above the floodwall carrying ordinary commuters through a city that has learned to make routine tidal problems manageable. Visual language: rain-streaked windows, passengers reading and talking, floodwalls below, calm route displays, wet city light.

S_lts_municipal_control_room.name: Harbor Phase — Municipal Control Room
S_lts_municipal_control_room.text: Harbor Phase — Municipal Control Room — Quiet infrastructure operations room. Human judgment genuinely matters during storms and failures; on an ordinary shift Matt mostly watches competent systems handle routine work. Visual language: blue-gray monitors, drainage maps, drone feeds, rain on glass, staffed but calm workstations.

S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.name: Harbor Phase — Covered Walkways
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.text: Harbor Phase — Covered Walkways — Lively covered public realm where people commute, meet, eat, shop, parent, and make plans. Comfortable civic life is real here. Visual language: wet paving, planted walkways, umbrellas, food stalls, families, commuters, warm storefronts and restrained civic lighting.

S_lts_inland_montage.name: Harbor Phase — Ordinary Adult Lives
S_lts_inland_montage.text: Harbor Phase — Ordinary Adult Lives — Cross-section of six functioning adult lives that fit differently: technical work, marine repair, risk review, serious physical training, ordinary plans, personal projects, and private routines. Visual language: specific practical interiors, workshops, climbing wall, screens, tools, kitchens, rain outside windows, personal clutter.

S_lts_inland_bar.name: Harbor Phase — Inland Bar
S_lts_inland_bar.text: Harbor Phase — Inland Bar — Warm, busy neighborhood bar where the old friend group actually enjoys itself. Their restlessness exists inside a socially alive city, not an empty room. Visual language: warm light against rain, crowded booths, regulars, pints, food, overlapping conversations, polished wet windows.

S_lts_inland_homes.name: Harbor Phase — Inland Homes and Prep Spaces
S_lts_inland_homes.text: Harbor Phase — Inland Homes and Prep Spaces — Distinct apartments, workshops, lockers, and kitchen tables where each person packs for the run around an existing adult life. Visual language: bags, boots, headlamps, tide screens, laundry, dishes, work gear, folded map, rain-lit windows, lived-in clutter.

S_lts_floodwall_ferry_lot.name: Floodwall / Old Ferry Lot
S_lts_floodwall_ferry_lot.text: Floodwall / Old Ferry Lot — Edge of inhabited Harbor Phase where tide runners gather with cheap gear before descending to the flats. Visual language: open trunks, wet pavement, headlamps, contractor work lights, tide boards, cheap gear, cold mist, floodwall mass.

S_lts_flood_steps.name: Floodwall Steps
S_lts_flood_steps.text: Floodwall Steps — Concrete steps and service access at the old ferry lot where runners descend from protected civic infrastructure onto exposed seabed. Visual language: wet concrete stairs, headlamps, warning boards, black mud below, floodwall looming behind, practical lights only.

S_lts_flats.name: The Flats
S_lts_flats.text: The Flats — Mud, old pavement, broken pilings, shallow pools, road fragments, channels, fog, and distance between Harbor Phase and the offshore district. Visual language: black tidal mud, boot suction, shell crunch, weak practical lights, fog swallowing depth, Harbor Phase dim behind.

S_lts_flats_service_roads.name: The Flats — Exposed Service Roads
S_lts_flats_service_roads.text: The Flats — Exposed Service Roads — Old submerged service road markings and access fragments emerge from mud as the crossing approaches offshore construction geometry. Visual language: broken road lines under black mud, rusted signs, shell debris, headlamp beams, rain, distant massive forms in fog.

S_lts_flats_sector_14.name: The Flats — Sector 14 Fragments
S_lts_flats_sector_14.text: The Flats — Sector 14 Fragments — Concrete foundations, transit fragments, and damaged Sector 14 signage protrude from the flats. Visual language: half-buried sign panels, concrete stubs, old transit markings, black water channels, fog and practical work lights.

S_lts_reach_first_sight.name: Offshore District — First Sight
S_lts_reach_first_sight.text: Offshore District — First Sight — The vast unfinished offshore district emerges through fog beyond the flats, too large to be dismissed as outskirts. Visual language: tower silhouettes, elevated structures, rain, fog, black tidal mirror, tiny figures dwarfed between Harbor Phase and the abandoned future.

S_lts_near_reach.name: Outer District / Outer Structures
S_lts_near_reach.text: Outer District / Outer Structures — Parking structures, broken pedestrian bridges, dead plazas, flooded service roads, support columns, and informal runner markings. Visual language: salt-stained concrete, floodlines, reflective tape, runner graffiti, black water moving through lower levels.

S_lts_reach_edge.name: District Edge
S_lts_reach_edge.text: District Edge — The first walkable edge of the offshore district where exposed access routes, broken decks, and water channels turn rumor into physical geography. Visual language: salt-stained concrete, black channels, broken ramps, fog, high dark shapes, route decisions under headlamps.

S_lts_reach_runner_marks.name: Offshore District — Runner Marks
S_lts_reach_runner_marks.text: Offshore District — Runner Marks — Arrows, warnings, timing claims, profanity, and runner tags layered over official abandoned infrastructure. Visual language: spray paint, reflective tape, scratched arrows, wet walls, crude warnings, practical beams catching letters.

S_lts_near_reach_structures.name: Outer District Structures
S_lts_near_reach_structures.text: Outer District Structures — Flooded decks, dead plazas, sagging walkways, and first audible signs of other runners farther in. Visual language: broken pedestrian bridges, wet metal, distant work lights, black water below, skeletal concrete, laughter in fog.

S_lts_reach_ramp.name: Offshore District — Wet Ramp
S_lts_reach_ramp.text: Offshore District — Wet Ramp — A slick ramp and elevated access route used to climb from the flats into the first accessible structures. Visual language: wet concrete incline, railings, slime, handheld lights, slipping boots, black water below.

S_lts_fashion_harbor_center.name: Fashion Harbor Center / Dead Mall
S_lts_fashion_harbor_center.text: Fashion Harbor Center / Dead Mall — A recent, canceled commercial-social future. Lower levels submerged, upper floors still accessible and temporarily occupied by runners. Visual language: escalators into black water, broken signage, food-court ghosts, dead advertisements, upper-level work lights, scattered runner occupation.

S_lts_mall_atrium.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Flooded Atrium
S_lts_mall_atrium.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Flooded Atrium — The central mall void, with black water filling lower levels and escalators descending into floodwater. Visual language: wide atrium, broken skylight, escalators into water, dead advertisements, dripping floors, practical beams over reflective black water.

S_lts_mall_upper_level.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Upper Level
S_lts_mall_upper_level.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Upper Level — Accessible upper floor where runners sit, argue routes, change socks, eat noodles, and rest under clipped work lights. Visual language: storefronts, dead kiosks, sleeping bags, headlamps, LED strips, wet tile, scattered humans making temporary use of abandoned space.

S_lts_mall_atrium_hold.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Atrium Hold
S_lts_mall_atrium_hold.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Atrium Hold — A pause above the flooded atrium where the group checks time, jokes, watches Justin wander, and feels the seduction of staying. Visual language: railing over black water, wet tile, runners in pockets of work light, damp jackets, route debates.

S_lts_mall_sportswear.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Sportswear Store
S_lts_mall_sportswear.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Sportswear Store — A half-looted sportswear store where Chris finds old branded clothing and the group roasts him. Visual language: fallen mannequins, damp racks, faded Harbor Phase Mariners gear, headlamp comedy, mud on glossy retail surfaces.

S_lts_mall_detail_sequence.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Detail Sequence
S_lts_mall_detail_sequence.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Detail Sequence — Food court, kiosks, transit access, play areas, ads, and silence; the mall still reads as designed for ordinary life. Visual language: food court signage, kiosk ghosts, play structure partly submerged, dead ads, no-signal screens, water stains.

S_lts_mall_map.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Map and Connections
S_lts_mall_map.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Map and Connections — Offline directory maps and faded route displays connect the mall to transit and residential districts; cracked screens, water damage, wet walls and figures huddled over the map.

S_lts_mall_leasing_display.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Leasing Display
S_lts_mall_leasing_display.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Leasing Display — Luxury residence and commercial leasing material for Harbor Phase East and the developer-branded Promise District, promising a future beside black floodwater. Visual language: glossy renderings, cracked display cases, model apartments, black floodwater outside, dead sales copy.

S_lts_mall_atrium_routes.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Route Decision
S_lts_mall_atrium_routes.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Route Decision — Contradictory runner advice, dangerous bridge options, and Ryan's practical route judgment inside the mall. Visual language: route graffiti, sagging bridge signs, black water visible through rails, group gathered in headlamp light.

S_lts_glass_rail.name: The Glass Rail
S_lts_glass_rail.text: The Glass Rail — Broken elevated rail line connecting the mall, Harbor Market, and deeper sectors; gives height, views, and false mastery. Visual language: broken panels, fog at height, black water below, skeletal supports, runner tags, wet metal.

S_lts_harbor_market_roof.name: Harbor Market Roof
S_lts_harbor_market_roof.text: Harbor Market Roof — Upper deck and roofline above flooded lower floors where runners gather while the tide is out. Visual language: work lights clipped to conduit, people on ventilation units, cheap beer, food, fog, drowned skyline, practical lights on roofs and bridges.

S_lts_deep_reach.name: Deep District
S_lts_deep_reach.text: Deep District — Unfinished schools, parks, housing, plazas, civic buildings, transit loops, clinics and community spaces under flat coastal light; ordinary municipal architecture, faded wayfinding, empty streets, tide marks and windblown debris.

S_lts_glass_rail_approach.name: Glass Rail — Approach
S_lts_glass_rail_approach.text: Glass Rail — Approach — approach to the broken elevated transit spine where fog reveals height, missing panels, and routes deeper into the offshore district Visual language: wet concrete ramps, skeletal rail supports, fog, black water below, runner tags, headlamps and clipped work lights.

S_lts_glass_rail_walkway.name: Glass Rail — Walkway
S_lts_glass_rail_walkway.text: Glass Rail — Walkway — narrow broken elevated walkway linking the dead mall to the rail and deeper sectors Visual language: wet metal decking, broken glass panels, black water below, fog at height, distant temporary runner lights.

S_lts_harbor_market_approach.name: Harbor Market — Approach
S_lts_harbor_market_approach.text: Harbor Market — Approach — approach through upper commercial structures toward the Harbor Market roof used as a runner gathering place Visual language: service decks, faded market signs, ventilation units, stairs, work lights, fog and wet concrete.

S_lts_harbor_market_exit.name: Harbor Market — Exit
S_lts_harbor_market_exit.text: Harbor Market — Exit — route away from the roof as runners pack out and the water starts coming back Visual language: wet exit stairs, shoulder lights, bags closing, black water visible below, fog swallowing the way back.

S_lts_harbor_market_stairs.name: Harbor Market — Stairs
S_lts_harbor_market_stairs.text: Harbor Market — Stairs — interior/exterior service stairs connecting market levels to the occupied roof Visual language: concrete stairs, rusted rails, old wayfinding, damp walls, headlamps and practical work lights.

S_lts_harbor_market_walkway.name: Harbor Market — Walkway
S_lts_harbor_market_walkway.text: Harbor Market — Walkway — elevated circulation around the market connecting roof spaces and rail approaches Visual language: wet walkway, broken canopy, ventilation housings, black water glimpses, taped route marks, fog.

S_lts_harbor_market_west_corner.name: Harbor Market Roof — West Corner
S_lts_harbor_market_west_corner.text: Harbor Market Roof — West Corner — quieter corner of the runner roof where the city and deeper district can both be seen Visual language: roof edge, vents, temporary seating, cheap beer, clipped LEDs, fog, drowned skyline and dark water.

S_lts_mall_corridor.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Exit Corridor
S_lts_mall_corridor.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Exit Corridor — upper mall corridor where returning water becomes visible through openings and route choices tighten Visual language: dead storefronts, wet tile, water reflections advancing, emergency signs, practical beams.

S_lts_mall_exit.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Exit
S_lts_mall_exit.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Exit — upper-level pack-out point leading from temporary runner occupation back outside Visual language: storefront shutters, bags, damp jackets, route marks, work lights, dark exterior beyond.

S_lts_mall_exterior.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Exterior
S_lts_mall_exterior.text: Fashion Harbor Center — Exterior — salt-stained exterior of the dead mall, weakly animated by temporary runner light during low tide Visual language: broad concrete facade, broken signage, clipped LEDs in upper levels, black water, fog.

S_lts_matt_apartment.name: Matt’s Apartment
S_lts_matt_apartment.text: Matt’s Apartment — ordinary comfortable apartment where practical gear begins to accumulate by the door as low tides reorganize his schedule Visual language: lived-in furniture, work jacket, boots, contractor bag, charging gear, rain-lit windows, no dystopian sterility.

S_lts_reach_junction.name: District — Route Junction
S_lts_reach_junction.text: District — Route Junction — physical fork where runner marks, elevation, water, and local judgment force a route choice Visual language: concrete junction, faded signs, spray arrows, puddles, rail shadows, fog and headlamp beams.

S_lts_return_route.name: The Return Route
S_lts_return_route.text: The Return Route — same flats and outer structures under a changing tide; familiar geography becomes harder as channels refill Visual language: rising black water, shrinking mud paths, wet concrete, hurried practical lights, fog, moving reflections.

R_lts_inland.name: Inland Harbor Phase
R_lts_inland.text: Inland Harbor Phase — Adapted coastal city of occupied apartments, raised transit, flood-control gates, shops, bars, workplaces, playgrounds, public screens and covered walkways. Soft gray-blue rain, civic glass, wet paving, warm interior windows and practical public lighting.

R_lts_threshold.name: Threshold / Floodwall
R_lts_threshold.text: Threshold / Floodwall — Old ferry lot, staging area, flood steps and tide boards against the massive floodwall. Wet asphalt, cold mist, open car trunks, vehicle headlights, contractor-white work lights and dark concrete.

R_lts_flats.name: The Flats
R_lts_flats.text: The Flats — Exposed seabed of black tidal mud, old pavement, channels, broken pilings, shell debris, shallow teal pools and dense fog. Boots sink and splash; distant sodium reflections shimmer across wet surfaces.

R_lts_reach.name: Offshore District
R_lts_reach.text: Offshore District — Salt-stained abandoned offshore districts exposed at low tide: wet concrete, rusted railings, flooded lower levels, broken walkways, black water, deep cyan fog and faded institutional-green surfaces. Headlamps and work lights fall off quickly in fog.
